pharmacology.text: 5-(Nonyloxy)tryptamine (5-NOT) is a tryptamine derivative which acts as a selective agonist at the 5-HT1B receptor. Increasing the O-alkoxy chain length in this series gives generally increasing potency and selectivity for 5-HT1B, with highest activity found for the nonyloxy derivative, having a 5-HT1B binding affinity of 1.0 nM, and around 300-fold selectivity over the related 5-HT1A receptor.

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of the serotonin 5-HT1B receptor.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素5-HT1B受體的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素5-HT1B受体的实验室研究。

fact.en: It carries a nine-carbon chain, which is remarkably long for a tryptamine. In this series, the longer the chain, the more the drug prefers the 5-HT1B receptor over 5-HT1A.
fact.zh: 它帶有一條九個碳的鏈，對色胺來說特別長。在這個系列中，鏈越長，藥物就越偏好5-HT1B受體而非5-HT1A。
fact.zhHans: 它带有一条九个碳的链，对色胺来说特别长。在这个系列中，链越长，药物就越偏好5-HT1B受体而非5-HT1A。
